purpose: D8 vs frozen D7 diagnostic completed-throughput; not upstream NI, latency quantiles, isolated management self or UMA/GPU qualification
integration_pair: Same common executable using D6/D7 API/ABI only, loaded with D7/D8 libraries. Expected generic requests per page frozen at before=1/after=0. Stable head during timing; both preserve captured read semantics.
native_pair: Unchanged native tiles3 fixture, D7/D8 libraries. Cached guard/read and true write controls detect indirect record/gate overhead; no fresh upstream comparison.
sampling: Eight independent process pairs per bucket. Rotate bucket order, alternate variant order. No profiler, no concurrent build or test workload. Warm payload and binding; scope capture/release included in integration. Read session/accessor touches one byte per page, rect copies the full rectangle.
limitations: Single thread/in-flight, H=0/1. No pre-frozen NI margin. Cold binding self, lock wait/hold, per-operation latency, high-H/concurrent performance and full background drain remain NotMeasured. History release/close measured separately. Different rate completion counts are not equal-work memory-efficiency evidence.
stopping: Stop on failed test, loader or source identity mismatch, wrong structural counter or window under 200ms. Preserve partial output. No changing the frozen protocol to pass; analyze only the complete matrix.
